name: XYZ-Aquila-mini
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: GQA plus gated linear attention: 30 of 40 layers are linear_attention and 10 are full_attention, one every fourth layer
notes: ADDED 2026-10-28 from the Qwen3.6-35B-A3B derivative query (443 likes, repo created 2026-07-22, 542 downloads at crawl). A post-train of Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, not a new base: config.json matches the base exactly (40 layers, hidden 2048, 16 query / 2 kv heads, head_dim 256, 256 experts with 8 routed per token, full_attention_interval 4), and the safetensors total of 35,107,181,936 is marginally SMALLER than the base's 35,951,822,704 - a 0.84B drop, so the tensor set is NOT byte-identical and at least some pruning or head/vocab surgery happened even though the card describes post-training only. That discrepancy is unresolved; do not treat the geometry as a straight inheritance without checking the index. PARAMS: safetensors 35,107,181,936 -> params_b 35.107; active_params_b 3.0 is inherited from the base record, not re-derived. WHAT IT IS: an agentic deep-search model (bounded-exploration 'AI4AI' pipeline) released with the open AxisAgentic harness. The card is explicit that the search/scrape/python tool implementations and context management are supplied by the harness, not the checkpoint - so its numbers are a system number, and its claimed 'highest in every column of the sub-40B comparison' is against three comparable-name baselines (Agents-A1, Nex-N2-mini, apodex-mini, MiroThinker 1.7 mini), only Agents-A1 of which the catalog already tracks. EVIDENCE SHAPE: seven rows, of which six beat the catalog's previous best on that test at this size and one (HLE) sits deliberately recorded as a loss-of-sorts because the card does not state whether tools were on. Hardware gate: 35.1B total at BF16 is 70 GB of weights, so it does not fit a 128 GiB budget with useful context - it is a recorded contender, not a runnable-on-this-box model. Licence apache-2.0.

benchmarks.name: GAIA
benchmarks.config: Card table 'Small-scale open-weight (<40B)', row GAIA, column 'XYZ-Aquila-mini'. Harness printed: ReAct-style search harness with web search, webpage extraction and stateful Python execution, max 256K context; the card says the tool implementations come from the open AxisAgentic harness, not the checkpoint. WINS vs Agents-A1 96.0 and MiroThinker 1.7 mini 80.3 on the same row; Nex-N2-mini and apodex-mini left blank. Catalog class best before this record was sage-a1-5 95.1.

benchmarks.name: BrowseComp
benchmarks.config: Same table, row BrowseComp. Accuracy. WINS vs Agents-A1 75.5, Nex-N2-mini 74.1, apodex-mini 71.5 and MiroThinker 1.7 mini 67.9. This is the single-agent number - unlike sage-a1-5's 82.8 it needs no opt-in subagent orchestration.

benchmarks.name: BrowseComp-ZH
benchmarks.config: Same table, row BrowseComp-ZH. Accuracy. WINS vs apodex-mini 80.6 and Nex-N2-mini 79.6 (that value dagger-marked as reproduced by the authors); Agents-A1 and MiroThinker rows are '--'. No prior BrowseComp-ZH row in the catalog at this size.

benchmarks.name: DeepSearchQA
benchmarks.config: Same table, row DeepSearchQA, metric F1 per the card's footnote. WINS vs Nex-N2-mini 87.2 (dagger: authors' reproduction) and apodex-mini 82.2. Catalog's only other DeepSearchQA row is mercury 71.33, a different class and card - not comparable.

benchmarks.name: LiveBrowseComp
benchmarks.config: Same table, row LiveBrowseComp. Accuracy. WINS vs Nex-N2-mini 41.4 (dagger), MiroThinker 1.7 mini 34.9 (dagger) and apodex-mini 32.8 (dagger); Agents-A1 29.6 (dagger). Largest margin in the row. No prior LiveBrowseComp row anywhere in the catalog.

benchmarks.name: WideSearch
benchmarks.config: Same table, row WideSearch, metric Item F1 Max@4 per the card's footnote. WINS vs Nex-N2-mini 62.0 and MiroThinker 1.7 mini 73.3 (dagger). Catalog's best wide-search row at this size was ornith-1-5-35b-a3b 67.8 on a different card and harness.

benchmarks.name: HLE
benchmarks.config: Same table, row HLE (Humanity's Last Exam). LOSS recorded deliberately: sage-a1-5 prints 55.1 on HLE w/ tools and bigbang-v1 50.3 on plain HLE, so this sits between them; the card does not say whether tools were enabled, which is exactly the ambiguity that makes the row hard to rank.
